title: Tenant-scoped tool Lambda, single-table DynamoDB and LeadingKeys
scenario: A ticket-lookup Lambda serves both the web app (HTTP API with a Cognito JWT authorizer) and the agent's tool layer. Brightline Health's pen test will forge the tenant in the path, the body and a prompt-injected tool argument. Build the boundary at every layer: token claim, handler, keys, IAM.
task: Single-table keys for four access patterns with tenant-prefixed partition keys
Pre token generation V2_0 trigger adding tenant_id to ID and access tokens, fail closed
HTTP API handler taking the tenant only from verified claims (403/404/400 semantics)
IAM policy with ForAllValues and dynamodb:LeadingKeys on a session tag
acceptance: Forged path, body, query and prompt-injected tool arguments all fail
Trigger shape, V1 and unmapped users handled; keys support every access pattern
No Scan or writes in the tool role; session tag passed on AssumeRole

practices.label: Week 4 Tue - pre token generation and tenant claims
Week 4 Thu - ABAC, session tags and LeadingKeys
